features.text: Advanced mesh upper design promotes airflow while providing essential support for post-surgical healing
Reinforced heel counter and padded collar work together to enhance rear foot stability and prevent slippage
Semi-rigid sole construction delivers superior protection and control following osteotomies
Extended straps with dual side closure system adapt to accommodate bulky dressings and swelling
Customizable fit with trimmable straps ensures comfort throughout the recovery process

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Consider additional space for swelling and bandaging when selecting your size.
